name: cycling-race-manager
description: Cycling Race & Team Management Application for Deliverable 5

scripts.init-db: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),sqlite3=require('sqlite3').verbose(),db=new sqlite3.Database('cycling.db');db.exec(fs.readFileSync('schema.sql','utf8') + '\n' + fs.readFileSync('insert_data.sql','utf8'), err => { if(err) console.error(err); else console.log('Database initialized successfully.'); db.close(); });"
